text:
A quick reminder, later this week
A calm fortnight is easier with a plan
Plain notice for travelers

Travelers with animals need to review the Companion Animal Travel Desk rules before arrival. Aurelia Skyways will only accept pets that meet the crate, handling, and check-in conditions set for safe boarding.

Please watch for the inserted sizing guidance in the middle of this notice. <<FACT F064>> Keep your paperwork ready, your carrier secure, and your pet calm through the whole journey. Staff may pause acceptance if the crate is unsafe, damaged, or not suitable for the animal inside. The team must protect the pet, the handlers, and other travelers, so do not arrive expecting a quick exception.

For birds, review the crate guidance with care before you travel. <<FACT F071>> If the crate does not match the required standard, boarding can be delayed or refused. Travelers should pack water, bedding, and any approved care items in a way that keeps the animal stable and comfortable. Clear labeling helps the desk move faster and reduces stress at the counter.

For help with a booking or a last-minute check, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
